medicalExemption.text: Vehicles exempted by the Director of the Department of Motor Vehicles because the owner has a medical condition requiring windows that allow less light than permitted.

penalty.text: $50 citation; vehicle must be inspected within 5 business days; if not brought into compliance, owner fined up to $1,000 (up to $5,000 on a second or subsequent finding); no points.

quotes: A front windshield or front side windows that allow less than 70% light transmittance; or (B) A rear windshield or rear side windows that allow less than 50% light transmittance.

no mini-van may be operated or parked ... with: (A) A front windshield or front side windows that allow less than 55% light transmittance, or (B) A rear windshield or rear side windows that allow less than 35% light transmittance.

openQuestions: Helmet (18 DCMR 2215.3) and radar-detector ban (18 DCMR 736) cites come from search results; the official dcregs.dc.gov text was not read. Federal bills H.R. 10067 / S. 5274 ('Ride in Freedom Act', 2026) would repeal the D.C. helmet rule; not enacted as far as seen.
